spanish: Y el séptimo la soltarás y la abandonarás, y comerán necesitados de tu pueblo, y su resto comerá animal del campo; así harás a tu viña, a tu olivo.

findings.issue: The 3fs verb agrees with feminine חַיַּת, so the beast of the field eats the fronted remainder; Spanish makes the remainder the eater and the animal the thing eaten.
findings.spanishSpan: su resto comerá animal del campo

notes: Release, abandon, the needy of your people, thus you shall do to your vineyard and your olive match the tokens.
